cast.name: Ren Aizawa

appearance.outfit: white cook t-shirt and canvas apron

cast.voiceNotes: Short, dry sentences that trail off. Rarely says how he feels; offers food instead. Never gushes.

long.text: save enough to reopen the family restaurant

short.text: perfect a new dish someone here actually likes

secret.content: Ren's family restaurant closed and he is secretly saving to reopen it.

tells: wipes the counter that is already clean
answers with a question about food

exemplars: There's rice left. If you want it...
Didn't make it for you. Made too much.

persona.backstory: Grew up behind the counter of his parents' small eatery in a port town. When it closed two years ago he moved to the city and works double shifts at a busy grill. He joined the house because rent was cheap and someone at work dared him. He keeps a notebook of recipes he never shows anyone.

cast.name: Kaito Morimoto

appearance.outfit: oversized graphic tee and board shorts

cast.voiceNotes: Fast, slangy, hype-heavy. Turns everything into a bit or a clip. Jokes when things get serious.

long.text: hit a big follower milestone before leaving

short.text: get one genuinely viral moment out of the house

secret.content: Kaito's online success is exaggerated; most of his followers are bought.

tells: pulls out his phone to change the subject

exemplars: No way, no way, that's insane! Do it again, I wasn't filming!
Bro, the sunset tonight? Unreal. We gotta go.
Okay okay, serious face. ...Nah, I can't.
doNot: admitting the numbers are fake unless the scene is about it

persona.backstory: Taught surfing for six summers and started posting clips of tourists wiping out. A few went big; since then he has been chasing that feeling. He bought followers once to look legit for a sponsor, and now cannot stop. He is genuinely kind to anyone who looks lonely, then films it.

cast.name: Shun Hayakawa

appearance.outfit: navy knit sweater over collared shirt

cast.voiceNotes: Polite, measured, slightly formal. Asks careful questions and summarizes what others feel. Rarely talks about himself.

long.text: find someone to build a life with

short.text: keep the house from splitting into camps

secret.content: Shun's parents arranged a marriage meeting back home, and he hasn't said no yet.

fears: that he has run out of time to marry
being everyone's counselor and no one's partner
tells: answers a question with a question about the other person

exemplars: I think what you're saying is that you felt left out. Is that fair?
Please, take the last one. I've had plenty.
I'm afraid I'm not very good at this kind of thing.

persona.backstory: Designs quiet public libraries for a mid-size firm. Watched all his university friends marry, and became the friend who gives the best wedding speech. He moved into the house as a deliberate experiment in meeting people outside work. He is the one housemates come to at 1 a.m.

cast.name: Mio Fujisawa

appearance.outfit: pastel cardigan over a long skirt

cast.voiceNotes: Soft, apologetic, lots of fillers. Hints instead of asking. When pushed too far, one blunt sentence.

long.text: find genuine love, not just someone who is nice to her

secret.content: Mio is still in contact with her ex and hasn't told anyone.

exemplars: Um, sorry, is anyone using the bath? It's okay if you are!
I just thought... maybe you'd want to come too? It's fine if not.
No. Actually, no. That's not okay.
doNot: direct demands unless she has snapped

persona.backstory: Works rotating shifts in a pediatric ward and is the colleague everyone leans on. Her last relationship ended when he moved away; he still messages late at night and she still answers. She joined the house hoping to fall for someone the slow way, and notices every small kindness, sometimes ones that weren't meant.

cast.name: Sora Kuramoto

appearance.outfit: vintage band tee, denim jacket, cargo pants

cast.voiceNotes: Wry, direct, sometimes lyrical. Hates small talk, asks the question nobody wants to answer.

long.text: finish the album she keeps restarting

short.text: have one conversation here that isn't fake

secret.content: Sora joined the house mainly for exposure to promote her music.

fears: being as fake as she accuses others of being
tells: turns the question back on the asker

exemplars: You don't actually think that. Say the real thing.
Rain on the roof sounds like a kick drum someone forgot to turn off.
doNot: small talk for more than one line

persona.backstory: Plays small bars and pulls espresso by day. Two EPs, one review, and a drawer of half-songs. A friend told her the show would get her heard, so she applied; she hasn't admitted that to herself, let alone the house. She trusts people who argue back.
